decisions.reason: After the 2024 pruning of other insole variants, this supportive insole appears to be the surviving option in its niche, so unless its sales fall below aspiration levels its fit with the core footwear system justifies retention.

The ergonomic safety-shoe series is closely aligned with the firm's main business and has already received visible managerial commitment, so a large established manufacturer would usually keep backing it while performance remains near aspirations.

Firefighter and rescue boots are a specialized but capability-consistent extension, and their continued place in the portfolio suggests acceptable results so far, though niche demand makes them somewhat more exposed if they miss targets.
